note: Scorecard: two contempt developments reported by outlets on Nov 3-4

event.label: reported
event.text: An advocate asked Maharashtra's Advocate General for consent to bring criminal contempt proceedings against a Cockroach Janta Party co-convenor over a November 3 post on X about judges hearing a Bombay High Court case, saying it attacked judicial integrity, the Free Press Journal reports. No response from the CJP was reported.

event.label: reported
event.text: Delhi government counsel gave consent for criminal contempt proceedings against the Cockroach Janta Party's legal head over posts alleging a Saket court judge acted on outside orders, calling his view prima facie; the Delhi High Court will decide whether the case goes ahead, ETV Bharat reports.
